title: echium creticum subsp. macranthum
intro: Echium creticum subsp. macranthum, commonly known as Cretan bugloss, is a plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, contributing to its potential health benefits such as wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Echium creticum subsp. macranthum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's therapeutic potential and its effects on human health.
